text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One morning.
I saw Win Variation on her way to school.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
choice_data_list: Good morning. Are you... not feeling well?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... good morning.
My headache is just a bit bad...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I've been rewatching race footage over and over lately...
so I think it's just eye strain..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I fell asleep without doing my eye care routine last night too...
I've got no one to blame but myself...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"To think I'd slack off on my self-management...
I'm so pathetic...!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If I don't take proper care of myself too—
Kgh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Win Variation would be plagued by a headache for a while.
